Network merger dependencies:

smali-dexlib2 3.0.9 — BSD 3-Clause; see Smali-BSD-3-Clause.txt.
Source: https://github.com/google/smali

Guava 31.1-android and failureaccess 1.0.1 — Apache License 2.0;
see Apache-2.0.txt. Source: https://github.com/google/guava

jsr305 3.0.2 is used as a build-time annotation library, not bundled as DEX code.

donor.jar is an extracted Android/OPlus runtime component. It retains its original
third-party licenses and is not relicensed under this project's GPL license.
